chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar reported, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abu `Abdillah al-Barqi, on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Sayf, on the authority of his brother `Ali, on the authority of al-Mufaddal ibn Salih, on the authority of `Ubayd ibn Zurarah, that Abu `Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The statement 'There is no god but Allah' is the price of Heaven.

key_terms.لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ: The declaration of monotheism (La ilaha illa Allah)

ai.seo_question: What is the price of Paradise according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Tawhid, Shaykh al-Saduq presents this narration from the chain of the Ahl al-Bayt to emphasize that Tawhid is not merely a verbal declaration but the fundamental 'price' (thaman) securing entry into Paradise. This aligns with the Shia theological view that sincere monotheism, encompassing both belief and practice, is the prerequisite for divine acceptance and eternal bliss.
